descriere: Sets the upper adaptation speed of the flux boost. Above this speed, the rated motor flux (100 %) is set as reference (setpoint) flux.
Sets the configuration for valve and cylinder.
Sets the hydraulic line length on the A side.
Sets the hydraulic line length on the B side.
Sets the piston position for minimum natural frequency.
Sets the natural frequency for the axis on the A side.
Sets the axis natural frequency at the center position.

This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identification routine (p1910). Induction motor, separately-excited synchronous motor: Sets the rotor leakage inductance of the motor. Synchronous motor: Sets the stator quadrature axis inductance of the motor.

Sets the damping resistance of the separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis). This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2).

Sets the stator direct-axis inductance of the synchronous motor. This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identification routine (p1910).

Sets the damping inductance of the separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis). This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2).

descriere_scurta: Motor magnetizing inductance/magn. inductance d axis saturated
descriere: Sets the magnetizing inductance of the motor. For separately-excited synchronous motors: Sets the saturated magnetizing inductance in the rotor direction (d-axis). This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2) or using the motor identification routine (p1910) (not for separately-excited synchronous motors).

descriere_scurta: Motor magnetizing inductance q axis saturated
descriere: Sets the saturated magnetizing inductance of the separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis). This parameter value is automatically calculated using the motor model (p0340 = 1, 2).

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (flux) for the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the first motor flux as a [%] referred to the rated motor flux. Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the first stator quadrature axis flux as a [%] referred to the product of the unsaturated quadrature inductance (p0356) and the rated motor current.

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (flux) for the 2nd value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the second motor flux as a [%] referred to the rated motor flux. Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the second stator quadrature axis flux as a [%] referred to the product of the unsaturated quadrature inductance (p0356) and the rated motor current.

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (flux) for the 3rd value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the third motor flux as a [%] referred to the rated motor flux. Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the third stator quadrature axis flux as a [%] referred to the product of the unsaturated quadrature inductance (p0356) and the rated motor current.

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate for the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the first magnetizing current as a [%] referred to the rated magnetizing current r0331 (ASM), which in turn is referred to the no-load excitation current (SESM). Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the first stator quadrature axis current as a [%] referred to the rated motor current (p0305).

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate for the 3rd value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the third magnetizing current as a [%] referred to the rated magnetizing current r0331 (ASM), which in turn is referred to the no-load excitation current (SESM). Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the third stator quadrature axis current as a [%] referred to the rated motor current (p0305).
Sets the rated no-load current (I_F0) for the excitation.

descriere_scurta: Current controller adaptation starting point KP
descriere: Sets the starting point of the current-dependent current controller adaptation where the current controller gain p1715 is effective.

descriere_scurta: Current controller adaptation p gain adaptation
descriere: Sets the factor for the current controller P gain in the adaptation range (current > p0392). The value is referred to p1715.
Maximum angle when calculating the polynomial function to decouple the magnetic flux axes for permanent-magnet synchronous motors (see p0398, p0399).

The magnetic cross coupling of the motor's d and q axes caused by saturation (current-dependent) leads to an angle offset affecting the axis system d'q'; this decouples the magnetic quantities. The angle offset can be described as a 3rd order polynomial function of the load current consumed: phiOffset = f(C1*iq + C3*iq^3) This parameter is the coefficient C1; it describes the linear load impact effect.

The magnetic cross coupling of the motor's d and q axes caused by saturation (current-dependent) leads to an angle offset affecting the axis system d'q'; this decouples the magnetic quantities. The angle offset can be described as a 3rd order polynomial function of the load current consumed: phiOffset = f(C1*iq + C3*iq^3) This parameter is the coefficient C3; it describes the cubic load impact effect.
Selects the encoder from the list of encoder types that the OEM supports.
Settings for the track A/B in a square-wave encoder. For square-wave encoders, p0404.3 must also be 1.
Sets the grid division for a linear encoder.
Sets the configuration for position tracking of a measuring gear.

descriere_scurta: Measuring gear absolute encoder rotary revolutions virtual
descriere: Sets the number of rotations that can be resolved for a rotary encoder with activated position tracking of the measuring gear.

descriere_scurta: Redundant coarse position value relevant bits (identified)
descriere: Sets the number of relevant bits for the redundant coarse position value.

descriere_scurta: Gx_XIST1 Coarse position safe most significant bit (identified)
descriere: Sets the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position.

descriere_scurta: Non safety-relevant meas. steps position value POS1 (detected)

Sets the comparison algorithm for the encoder position monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: Fine resolution absolute value Gx_XIST2 (in bits)

Selecting the encoder connection.

descriere: Sets the resolution of the absolute position for a linear absolute encoder.
Sets the number of measuring steps per revolution for a rotary absolute encoder. The resolution refers to the absolute position.
Sets the distance between two zero marks for a linear encoder. This information is used for zero mark monitoring.
Sets the differential distance with distance-coded zero marks [signal periods]. The value corresponds to jump displacement of "zero mark with interference".
Sets the baud rate for an SSI encoder.
Sets the minimum delay time between two data transfers of the absolute value for an SSI encoder.

Sets the motor and load revolutions for the gearbox factor of the encoder evaluation. The gearbox factor specifies the ratio between the encoder shaft and motor shaft (for motor encoders) or between the encoder shaft and the load.
Sets the position and level of the error bit in the SSI protocol.
Sets the position and parity of the parity bit in the SSI protocol.
Sets the extended configuration of the Sensor Module.

Serial number part 2 of the encoder for the commissioning.
Serial number part 3 of the encoder for the commissioning.
Serial number part 4 of the encoder for the commissioning.

descriere_scurta: Encoder SSI number of bits before the absolute value
descriere: Sets the number of bits before the absolute value in the SSI protocol.

descriere_scurta: Encoder SSI number of bits absolute value
descriere: Sets the number of bits for the absolute value in the SSI protocol.

descriere_scurta: Encoder SSI number of bits after the absolute value
descriere: Sets the number of bits after the absolute value in the SSI protocol.

descriere_scurta: Encoder SSI number of bits filler bits
descriere: Sets the number of filler bits for double absolute value transfer in the SSI protocol.

descriere_scurta: Pulse encoder evaluation zero speed measuring time
descriere: Sets the measuring time for evaluating zero speed. If no pulses are detected from track A/B during this time, a speed actual value of zero is output.

descriere_scurta: Manipulated variable filter denominator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for manipulated variable filter (PT2, general filter).

Display and setting the code number of the bearing. When setting p0301 and p0530 the code number is automatically preassigned and is write protected. The information in p0530 should be observed when removing write protection.

Sets the maximum speed of the bearing. The following applies when calculating the maximum speed (p1082): - for p0324 = 0 or p0532 = 0, p0322 is used. - for p0324 > 0 and p0532 > 0, the minimum value from the two parameters is used.

Setting for activating/de-activating the inhibit list. Depending on the setting, the parameters of the inhibit list (p0571) should be overwritten when calculating the motor and closed-loop control parameters for the particular drive data set (DDS).
Sets the sensor type of the second temperature sensor for the motor temperature monitoring.

Sets the alarm threshold for monitoring the motor temperature for motor temperature model 2 or KTY. After the alarm threshold is exceeded, alarm A07910 is output and timer (p0606) is started. If the delay time has expired and the alarm threshold has, in the meantime, not been fallen below, then fault F07011 is output.

Sets the timer for monitoring the motor temperature for motor temperature model 2 or KTY. This timer is started when the temperature alarm threshold (p0604) is exceeded. If the timer has expired and the alarm threshold has, in the meantime, not been fallen below, then fault F07011 is output. If the temperature fault threshold (p0605) is prematurely exceeded before the timer has expired, then fault F07011 is immediately output.

Sets the timer between the output of alarm and fault for a temperature sensor fault. If there is a sensor fault, this timer is started. If the sensor fault is still present after the timer has expired, a corresponding fault is output.

descriere_scurta: I2t motor model thermal time constant
descriere: Sets the winding time constant. The time constant specifies the warm-up time of the cold stator winding when loaded with the motor standstill current (rated motor current, if the motor standstill current is not parameterized) up until a temperature rise of 63 % of the continuously permissible winding temperature has been reached.

Sets the reduction factor for the overtemperature of the thermal adaptation of the stator/rotor resistance. The value is a starting value when switching on. Internally, after switch-on, the reduction factor has no effect corresponding to the thermal time constant.
Sets the alarm threshold 1 for monitoring the motor temperature.
Thermally relevant iron component of the motor as a percentage of p0344.
Thermally relevant copper component of the motor as a percentage of p0344.
Thermally relevant weight of the motor as a percentage of p0344.

descriere_scurta: Thermal adaptation, stator and rotor resistance
descriere: Sets the thermal adaptation of the stator/primary section resistance and rotor/secondary section resistance according to r0395 and r0396.

Selects the identification of the stator resistance after booting the Control Unit (only for vector control). The identification is used to measure the actual stator resistance and from the ratio of the result of motor data identification (p0350) to the matching ambient temperature (p0625) the actual mean temperature of the stator winding is calculated. The result is used to initialize the thermal motor model.

Sets the temperature offset for the PT100 measured value. If there is a difference between the motor temperature displayed in r0035 and the actual motor temperature, this offset can be entered in this parameter, thereby compensating for the difference.
Defines the rated overtemperature of the stator core referred to the ambient temperature.
Defines the rated overtemperature of the stator winding referred to the ambient temperature.
Reference value for the identification of the stator resistance every time the drive is powered up.

descriere_scurta: Q flux quadrature axis current constant unsaturated
descriere: The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. This parameter describes the interdependency of the unsaturated component of the quadrature axis current.
The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. This parameter describes the gradients of the saturated component over the quadrature axis current.
Sets the reduction for the current limit in encoderless operation. The value is referred to p0640.
Sets the overvoltage protection for synchronous motors in the field-weakening range.
Maximum excitation current of the induction motor referred to the permissible rated current of the power unit (r0207[0]).
Sets the constant kT5 for the kT characteristic. kT(iq) = kT1 + kT3 * iq^2 + kT5 * iq^4 + kT7 * iq^6
Sets the constant kT7 for the kT characteristic. kT(iq) = kT1 + kT3 * iq^2 + kT5 * iq^4 + kT7 * iq^6

Displays the operating hours for the corresponding motor. The motor operating time counter continues to run when the pulses are enabled. When the pulse enable is withdrawn, the counter is held and the value saved.
Sets the factor to evaluate the stator resistance.
Sets the factor to evaluate the stator leakage induction.
